**(b) The 36-parameter joint-orbit family** (comment 024 §8).
The pilot searched six one-dimensional directions (three spatial stars × one
momentum star, amplitude and phase separately). Comment 024 §8 proposes the
joint family: several spatial stars × several momentum stars (direct-lattice
stars T1, T2, ...), amplitude and phase together. Map which couplings
matter before going wide: small signed steps, one block at a time, then
combinations of the ones that survive on both screen clusters.
